items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Arthur Lee Roller. Yeah. he played with me. Nice alto man.

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard that Lafayette told me about it when I went out there in 60, 59. I asked about Melvin. And Johnny died too, you know. Oh, yeah. The trombone player. What was his name, Johnny what? Johnny Shields. Johnny Shields.

Well look, you said you had this alto man playing with you and Robert. Roll. Yeah, well you know, when I left the California, Roland played at Lewis's, the Chinese Garden with me when I moved in there from the California. Yeah. He played there with me a long time. Yeah, Roland. Four nights a week, you know, at that Chinese place. Arthur Lee Roller. Yeah. On Old Second and Arc in there. Arthur Lee Roller. Yeah, he played with me. Nice alto man. Young cat.
Fine. But he's flying. Oh, yes he is. Oh, he's fighting a minute. Oh, yeah. Nice educated boy, high school education. Oh, yeah. From Tulsa, Oklahoma.
